children: CBOT December corn (CZ26) may revisit its September 2 high of $5.49-3/4 per bushel, as the uptrend from $4.57-1/2 could have resumed.
The resumption was confirmed by a bullish wedge and the strong surge on Monday. A projection analysis on the uptrend from $4.70-1/2 marks supports and resistances.
The nearest support is at $5.39-3/4, a break below which may trigger a fall into $5.33-3/4 to $5.37-1/4 range. The fall will be classified as a pullback toward the wedge.
